en: Great men are they who see that spiritual is stronger than any material force, that thoughts rule the world.
zh: 伟大的人看得出：精神比任何物质力量都强大，思想统治着世界。
line: Great men are they who see that spiritual is stronger than any material force, that thoughts rule the world. — Ralph Waldo Emerson

word.ex: I participated in a photography competition.
word.exzh: 我参加了一个摄影比赛。
